title: potentilla turczaninowiana subsp. kuramensis
intro: Potentilla turczaninowiana subsp. kuramensis, commonly known as the Himalayan potentilla, is a plant species that belongs to the rose family (Rosaceae) and is native to the Himalayan region. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, offering various health benefits such as anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial activities. The therapeutic actions of Potentilla turczaninowiana subsp. kuramensis include wound healing, anti-diabetic, and anti-cancer properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
